title: "Differential abundance between bone-marrow sample groups"
author: "LazDaria, ArthurDondi"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  workflowr::wflow_html
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: inline
params:
  input: !r Sys.getenv("MAPMET2_INPUT", "/mnt/data/input_all")
  output: !r Sys.getenv("MAPMET2_OUTPUT", "/mnt/data/output_mapmet2")
  # Samples with fewer cells are left out (as in 05.1)
  min_cells: 100
  # Within a compartment (e.g. tumor cells), samples with fewer cells in that
  # compartment are left out of that analysis
  min_cells_compartment: 10
  # FDR cutoff used to mark significant results
  fdr: 0.1
  # 05.1 variant whose communities are compared (communities_BM_<variant>.csv);
  # "" = no community comparison
  community_variant: "all_without_controls"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
plot_dir <- file.path(params$output, "plots/05.2_BM_DA")
if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
  dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

date_prefix <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")

# Save a plot (ggplot / patchwork) as PDF or PNG, by file extension
save_plot <- function(plot_obj, filename, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  full_path <- file.path(plot_dir, paste0(date_prefix, "_", filename))
  ggsave(full_path, plot = plot_obj, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi,
         bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE)
  message("Saved: ", full_path)
}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  error = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  dev = "png",
  dpi = 300,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 6
)
```

# Differential abundance in bone-marrow samples {#bm-da}

Adapted from MapMetSC's `05.2_PT_DE_DA.Rmd`, which compares MNA and nMNA diagnostic primary tumors and two cellular communities. Here we test for differential cell-type abundance between groups of **bone-marrow samples**. Comparisons are named `<A>_vs_<B>`: **logFC = log2(abundance in A / abundance in B)**, i.e. positive = more abundant in A, the first-named group.

| comparison | design |
|---|---|
| `DE_vs_ctrl`, `T1_vs_ctrl`, `T2_vs_ctrl`: patient BM vs normal control BM | unpaired |
| `T1_vs_DE`, `T2_vs_DE`, `T2_vs_T1`: course of the disease | paired: only patients sampled at both timepoints, patient as blocking factor |
| `REL_vs_DE`: relapse | unpaired (the few patients with both samples are blocked) |
| `MNA_vs_nMNA_DE`, `MNA_vs_nMNA_T2`: genetic subtype at DE / at T2 | unpaired; MYCN-heterogeneous and unknown samples are left out |
| `comm<j>_vs_comm<i>`: cellular communities of 05.1 (`r if (nzchar(params$community_variant)) params$community_variant else "none"`) | unpaired; patients with samples in both communities are blocked |

Each comparison is run at four levels, as in MapMetSC: metaclusters, all cell types, tumor cell types (within the tumor cells) and immune cell types (within the immune cells, i.e. all metaclusters except `tumor`, `mesenchymal` and `other`). Comparing immune cell types within the immune compartment keeps the tumor infiltration of the patient BM from lowering every immune proportion. The tumor level is skipped for the comparisons with the control BM, which has no tumor cells.

## Load libraries
<details>
   <summary>Load libraries</summary>

```{r load-libraries}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(diffcyt)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
```
</details>

## Read data
We load the phenotyped single-cell data from [chapter 4](04_phenotyping.html): the expression of the clustering channels (`use_channel`, as MapMetSC's DA input) and one row per cell with its sample (`fm_id`), patient, BM sample type and MYCN status.

```{r read-data}
spe <- readRDS(file.path(params$output, "spe_04_phenotyping.rds"))

for (mapmet_cc_path in c("analysis/00_MapMet_color_code.R", "00_MapMet_color_code.R", "../analysis/00_MapMet_color_code.R"))
  if (file.exists(mapmet_cc_path)) { source(mapmet_cc_path); break }

col_celltype    <- metadata(spe)$color_vectors$col_celltype_ordered
col_metacluster <- metadata(spe)$color_vectors$col_metacluster
ct_levels       <- levels(spe$celltype_ordered)

keep_rows <- if ("use_channel" %in% colnames(rowData(spe))) rowData(spe)$use_channel else rep(TRUE, nrow(spe))
expr      <- as.matrix(assay(spe, "counts")[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE])   # markers x cells

cells <- as.data.frame(colData(spe))[, c("fm_id", "patient_id", "timepoint", "celltype", "metacluster", "MYCN_amp")]
cells$idx         <- seq_len(nrow(cells))                                   # column in `expr`
cells$celltype    <- factor(as.character(cells$celltype), levels = ct_levels)
cells$metacluster <- factor(as.character(cells$metacluster),
                            levels = intersect(names(col_metacluster), unique(as.character(cells$metacluster))))
rm(spe); invisible(gc())

# Samples with too few cells are left out
n_per_sample <- table(cells$fm_id)
too_small    <- names(n_per_sample)[n_per_sample < params$min_cells]
if (length(too_small))
  message(length(too_small), " sample(s) with < ", params$min_cells, " cells left out: ",
          paste(too_small, collapse = ", "))
cells <- cells[!cells$fm_id %in% too_small, ]

# MYCN status: MNA / nMNA / het / unknown (as in MapMetSC); not applicable to controls
mna_of <- function(x) dplyr::recode(as.character(x),
  "1" = "MNA", "0" = "nMNA", "2" = "het", "9" = "unknown",
  "MNA" = "MNA", "nMNA" = "nMNA", "het" = "het", "yes" = "MNA", "no" = "nMNA",
  .default = "unknown", .missing = "unknown")

samples <- cells %>%
  group_by(fm_id) %>%
  summarise(patient_id = first(as.character(patient_id)),
            timepoint  = first(as.character(timepoint)),
            mna        = mna_of(first(MYCN_amp)),
            n_cells    = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  as.data.frame()
samples$mna[samples$timepoint == "control"] <- NA
# A sample without a patient id is its own patient (no blocking)
no_pid <- is.na(samples$patient_id) | samples$patient_id %in% c("", "NA")
samples$patient_id[no_pid] <- paste0("sample_", samples$fm_id[no_pid])
rownames(samples) <- samples$fm_id

# Cellular communities from 05.1
samples$community <- NA_character_
comm_file <- file.path(params$output, paste0("communities_BM_", params$community_variant, ".csv"))
if (nzchar(params$community_variant)) {
  if (file.exists(comm_file)) {
    comm <- read.csv(comm_file, colClasses = c(fm_id = "character"))
    samples$community <- as.character(comm$community[match(samples$fm_id, comm$fm_id)])
  } else message("Community file not found (", comm_file, "): community comparisons skipped. Run 05.1 first.")
}

knitr::kable(as.data.frame.matrix(table(timepoint = factor(samples$timepoint, levels = TIMEPOINT_LEVELS),
                                        MYCN = addNA(factor(samples$mna)))),
             caption = "Samples per BM sample type and MYCN status")

# Immune compartment (as in 05.1: not tumor, mesenchymal or other)
immune_meta <- setdiff(levels(droplevels(cells$metacluster)), c("tumor", "mesenchymal", "other"))
```

## Comparisons

```{r define-comparisons}
# Named <A>_vs_<B>: A = g2, B = g1 (reference), logFC = log2(A / B).
# `paired = TRUE` keeps only the patients sampled in both groups. `within`
# restricts the samples to one BM sample type (MYCN comparisons).
comparisons <- list(
  DE_vs_ctrl     = list(var = "timepoint", g1 = "control", g2 = "DE",  paired = FALSE),
  T1_vs_ctrl     = list(var = "timepoint", g1 = "control", g2 = "T1",  paired = FALSE),
  T2_vs_ctrl     = list(var = "timepoint", g1 = "control", g2 = "T2",  paired = FALSE),
  T1_vs_DE       = list(var = "timepoint", g1 = "DE",      g2 = "T1",  paired = TRUE),
  T2_vs_DE       = list(var = "timepoint", g1 = "DE",      g2 = "T2",  paired = TRUE),
  T2_vs_T1       = list(var = "timepoint", g1 = "T1",      g2 = "T2",  paired = TRUE),
  REL_vs_DE      = list(var = "timepoint", g1 = "DE",      g2 = "REL", paired = FALSE),
  MNA_vs_nMNA_DE = list(var = "mna", g1 = "nMNA", g2 = "MNA", paired = FALSE, within = "DE"),
  MNA_vs_nMNA_T2 = list(var = "mna", g1 = "nMNA", g2 = "MNA", paired = FALSE, within = "T2")
)
# Every pair of communities (community 1 = the largest)
comm_levels <- sort(unique(na.omit(samples$community)))
if (length(comm_levels) >= 2) {
  for (pr in combn(comm_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE))
    comparisons[[paste0("comm", pr[2], "_vs_comm", pr[1])]] <-
      list(var = "community", g1 = pr[1], g2 = pr[2], paired = FALSE)
}

# Cluster levels: metaclusters, all cell types, tumor and immune cell types
levels_cfg <- list(
  metacluster     = list(var = "metacluster", compartment = NULL,         min_samples_frac = NULL),
  celltype_all    = list(var = "celltype",    compartment = NULL,         min_samples_frac = NULL),
  celltype_tumor  = list(var = "celltype",    compartment = "tumor",      min_samples_frac = 0.2),
  celltype_immune = list(var = "celltype",    compartment = immune_meta,  min_samples_frac = NULL)
)

# Samples of each comparison
comparison_samples <- function(cmp) {
  s <- samples
  if (!is.null(cmp$within)) s <- s[s$timepoint == cmp$within, ]
  s <- s[!is.na(s[[cmp$var]]) & s[[cmp$var]] %in% c(cmp$g1, cmp$g2), ]
  s$condition <- factor(s[[cmp$var]], levels = c(cmp$g1, cmp$g2))
  if (isTRUE(cmp$paired)) {
    both <- intersect(s$patient_id[s$condition == cmp$g1], s$patient_id[s$condition == cmp$g2])
    s <- s[s$patient_id %in% both, ]
  }
  s
}

overview <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(comparisons), function(nm) {
  cmp <- comparisons[[nm]]; s <- comparison_samples(cmp)
  data.frame(comparison = nm, design = if (isTRUE(cmp$paired)) "paired" else "unpaired",
             A = cmp$g2, n_A = sum(s$condition == cmp$g2),
             B = cmp$g1, n_B = sum(s$condition == cmp$g1),
             patients = length(unique(s$patient_id)))
}))
knitr::kable(overview, caption = "Samples per comparison (after the cell-count filter); logFC = log2(A / B)")
```

## DA test

As in MapMetSC, each analysis builds a diffcyt object from the per-sample cell tables (`prepareData`, `transformData`), sets the cluster of every cell, counts cells per cluster and sample (`calcCounts`) and tests with `testDA_voom` ([Weber et al. 2019](https://doi.org/10.1038/s42003-019-0415-5)) on the design `~ condition` with `min_cells = 3` and `min_samples = 1` (20% of the samples for the tumor cell types). In addition to MapMetSC, when patients contribute several samples (paired comparisons, and any patient present in both groups otherwise), the patient is passed as `block_id`, which `testDA_voom` handles with limma's `duplicateCorrelation`; when that correlation cannot be estimated, the test is run without the block. P-values are adjusted per analysis (Benjamini-Hochberg). Unlike MapMetSC's script, the logFC is not sign-flipped: with the condition levels (B, A) and `createContrast(c(0, 1))`, `testDA_voom` returns log2(A / B).

```{r da-function}
stars <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "", ifelse(p < 0.001, "***", ifelse(p < 0.01, "**",
                     ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", ifelse(p < params$fdr, ".", "")))))

marker_info <- data.frame(channel_name = rownames(expr), marker_name = rownames(expr),
                          marker_class = factor("type", levels = c("type", "state", "none")))

# One analysis: one comparison at one cluster level -> results + grouped boxplot
run_da <- function(cmp_name, lvl_name) {
  cmp <- comparisons[[cmp_name]]; lvl <- levels_cfg[[lvl_name]]
  s   <- comparison_samples(cmp)
  d   <- cells[cells$fm_id %in% s$fm_id, ]
  if (!is.null(lvl$compartment)) d <- d[as.character(d$metacluster) %in% lvl$compartment, ]
  d$cluster_id <- droplevels(d[[lvl$var]])
  d <- d[!is.na(d$cluster_id), ]

  # samples with too few cells in the compartment are left out
  n_comp <- table(factor(d$fm_id, levels = s$fm_id))
  s <- s[s$fm_id %in% names(n_comp)[n_comp >= params$min_cells_compartment], ]
  if (isTRUE(cmp$paired)) {
    both <- intersect(s$patient_id[s$condition == cmp$g1], s$patient_id[s$condition == cmp$g2])
    s <- s[s$patient_id %in% both, ]
  }
  n_g <- table(s$condition)
  if (any(n_g < 2)) {
    message("Skipped ", cmp_name, " / ", lvl_name, ": fewer than 2 samples in a group (",
            paste(names(n_g), n_g, sep = " = ", collapse = ", "), ")")
    return(NULL)
  }
  d <- d[d$fm_id %in% s$fm_id, ]
  d$cluster_id <- droplevels(d$cluster_id)

  # ---- diffcyt input, as in MapMetSC ----
  experiment_info <- data.frame(sample_id = factor(s$fm_id, levels = s$fm_id),
                                condition = s$condition, patient_id = factor(s$patient_id))
  cells_by_sample <- split(d, factor(d$fm_id, levels = s$fm_id))
  df_list <- lapply(cells_by_sample, function(x) as.data.frame(t(expr[, x$idx, drop = FALSE])))
  d_se <- prepareData(df_list, experiment_info, marker_info)
  rowData(d_se)$cluster_id <- factor(unlist(lapply(cells_by_sample, function(x) as.character(x$cluster_id)),
                                            use.names = FALSE), levels = levels(d$cluster_id))
  metadata(d_se)$cluster_codes <- data.frame(cluster_id = levels(d$cluster_id))
  d_se     <- transformData(d_se)
  d_counts <- calcCounts(d_se)
  if (!is.null(colnames(d_counts)))
    stopifnot(identical(colnames(d_counts), as.character(experiment_info$sample_id)))

  design      <- createDesignMatrix(experiment_info, cols_design = "condition")
  contrast    <- createContrast(c(0, 1))                        # log2(A / B)
  min_samples <- if (!is.null(lvl$min_samples_frac)) max(1, round(ncol(d_counts) * lvl$min_samples_frac)) else 1
  blocked     <- any(duplicated(experiment_info$patient_id))
  res_DA <- NULL
  if (blocked)
    res_DA <- tryCatch(testDA_voom(d_counts, design, contrast, block_id = experiment_info$patient_id,
                                   min_cells = 3, min_samples = min_samples),
                       error = function(e) { message("Patient block not estimable for ", cmp_name, " / ",
                                                     lvl_name, " (", conditionMessage(e), "): test without block"); NULL })
  if (is.null(res_DA)) {
    blocked <- FALSE
    res_DA  <- testDA_voom(d_counts, design, contrast, min_cells = 3, min_samples = min_samples)
  }
  res <- data.frame(rowData(res_DA))
  res$cluster_id <- as.character(res$cluster_id)
  res <- cbind(comparison = cmp_name, level = lvl_name, A = cmp$g2, B = cmp$g1,
               n_A = n_g[[cmp$g2]], n_B = n_g[[cmp$g1]],
               design = if (isTRUE(cmp$paired)) "paired" else "unpaired", patient_block = blocked,
               res[, intersect(c("cluster_id", "logFC", "AveExpr", "t", "p_val", "p_adj"), colnames(res))])

  # ---- per-sample abundances (% of the cells in the compartment) ----
  counts <- unclass(table(d$cluster_id, factor(d$fm_id, levels = s$fm_id)))
  counts <- matrix(counts, nrow = nrow(counts), dimnames = dimnames(counts))
  freq <- as.data.frame(as.table(sweep(counts, 2, colSums(counts), "/") * 100), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(freq) <- c("cluster_id", "fm_id", "Freq")
  freq$condition <- factor(s[freq$fm_id, "condition"], levels = c(cmp$g1, cmp$g2))
  freq$patient   <- s[freq$fm_id, "patient_id"]
  cl_present     <- rownames(counts)

  # ---- grouped boxplot on a numeric x axis (as in MapMetSC) ----
  ct_idx   <- setNames(seq_along(cl_present), cl_present)
  cond_off <- setNames(c(-0.2, 0.2), c(cmp$g1, cmp$g2))
  freq$xpos <- ct_idx[freq$cluster_id] + cond_off[as.character(freq$condition)]
  freq$box  <- interaction(freq$cluster_id, freq$condition, drop = TRUE)

  stats_df <- data.frame(cluster_id = cl_present, xc = ct_idx[cl_present],
                         y = vapply(cl_present, function(cl) max(freq$Freq[freq$cluster_id == cl]), numeric(1)),
                         p_adj = res$p_adj[match(cl_present, res$cluster_id)])
  stats_df$label <- ifelse(is.na(stats_df$p_adj), "n.t.",
                           paste0("p=", signif(stats_df$p_adj, 2), " ", stars(stats_df$p_adj)))
  stats_df$y <- stats_df$y * 1.05
  y_tip <- 0.02 * max(stats_df$y)

  col_vec <- if (lvl$var == "metacluster") col_metacluster else col_celltype
  cl_cols <- col_vec[cl_present]; cl_cols[is.na(cl_cols)] <- "gray50"; names(cl_cols) <- cl_present
  x_lims  <- c(0.5, length(cl_present) + 0.5)
  box_df  <- data.frame(x = as.vector(outer(cond_off, ct_idx, "+")),
                        cond = rep(names(cond_off), times = length(cl_present)))
  if (cmp$var == "community") box_df$cond <- paste("comm.", box_df$cond)

  p_main <- ggplot(freq, aes(x = xpos, y = Freq, group = box)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = cluster_id, colour = cluster_id), position = "identity", width = 0.32,
                 outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.45, show.legend = FALSE)
  if (isTRUE(cmp$paired)) {
    # paired samples: points without jitter, joined per patient
    p_main <- p_main +
      geom_line(aes(group = interaction(patient, cluster_id)), colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_point(aes(colour = cluster_id), size = 0.9, alpha = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE)
  } else {
    p_main <- p_main +
      geom_jitter(aes(colour = cluster_id), width = 0.07, height = 0, size = 0.9, alpha = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE)
  }
  p_main <- p_main +
    geom_segment(data = stats_df, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3, aes(x = xc - 0.2, xend = xc + 0.2, y = y, yend = y)) +
    geom_segment(data = stats_df, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3, aes(x = xc - 0.2, xend = xc - 0.2, y = y - y_tip, yend = y)) +
    geom_segment(data = stats_df, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3, aes(x = xc + 0.2, xend = xc + 0.2, y = y - y_tip, yend = y)) +
    geom_text(data = stats_df, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.4, vjust = -0.3, aes(x = xc, y = y, label = label)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cl_cols) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cl_cols) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = box_df$x, labels = box_df$cond, limits = x_lims, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.18))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "% abundance",
         title = paste0(lvl_name, ": ", cmp_name,
                        "  [", cmp$g2, " n = ", n_g[[cmp$g2]], ", ", cmp$g1, " n = ", n_g[[cmp$g1]],
                        if (isTRUE(cmp$paired)) paste0("; paired, ", length(unique(s$patient_id)), " patients") else "",
                        "; testDA_voom", if (blocked) " + patient block" else "", ", BH]")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 7),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 9), plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 2, 5))

  p_lab <- ggplot(data.frame(x = seq_along(cl_present), label = cl_present), aes(x, 1, label = label)) +
    geom_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 2.8) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_lims, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_void() + theme(plot.margin = margin(2, 5, 34, 5))

  p <- p_main / p_lab + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.42))
  print(p)
  save_plot(p, paste0("boxplot_", cmp_name, "_", lvl_name, ".pdf"),
            width = max(5, length(cl_present) * 0.55 + 1.5),
            height = if (any(nchar(cl_present) > 6)) 5 else 4)
  res
}
```

## Results

```{r run-all, fig.width=14, fig.height=5, results="asis"}
all_res <- list()
for (cmp_name in names(comparisons)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", cmp_name, "\n\n", sep = "")
  for (lvl_name in names(levels_cfg)) {
    involves_ctrl <- "control" %in% c(comparisons[[cmp_name]]$g1, comparisons[[cmp_name]]$g2)
    if (lvl_name == "celltype_tumor" && involves_ctrl) next   # no tumor cells in the controls
    r <- run_da(cmp_name, lvl_name)
    if (!is.null(r)) all_res[[paste(cmp_name, lvl_name)]] <- r
  }
}
da_results <- do.call(rbind, all_res)
rownames(da_results) <- NULL
write.csv(da_results, file.path(params$output, "DA_BM_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

All results are saved to `DA_BM_results.csv` in the output folder. Results with an adjusted p-value below `r params$fdr`:

```{r significant}
sig <- da_results[!is.na(da_results$p_adj) & da_results$p_adj < params$fdr,
                  c("comparison", "level", "cluster_id", "n_A", "n_B", "logFC", "p_adj")]
knitr::kable(sig[order(sig$comparison, sig$level, sig$p_adj), ], digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Overview

One panel per cluster level: every comparison `<A>_vs_<B>` (columns) for every cluster (rows), colored by logFC = log2(A / B) (red: more abundant in A, the first-named group; blue: more abundant in B) and sized by -log10 adjusted p-value (capped at 10); black outline = adjusted p < `r params$fdr`.

```{r overview, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
for (lvl_name in unique(da_results$level)) {
  d <- da_results[da_results$level == lvl_name & !is.na(da_results$p_adj), ]
  if (!nrow(d)) next
  cl_order <- if (lvl_name == "metacluster") names(col_metacluster) else ct_levels
  d$cluster_id <- factor(d$cluster_id, levels = rev(intersect(cl_order, unique(d$cluster_id))))
  d$comparison <- factor(d$comparison, levels = names(comparisons))
  lim <- max(abs(d$logFC), na.rm = TRUE)
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(comparison, cluster_id)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = logFC, size = pmin(-log10(p_adj), 10), colour = p_adj < params$fdr), shape = 21, stroke = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B", limits = c(-lim, lim),
                         name = "logFC\nlog2(A / B)\nA_vs_B") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "black", `FALSE` = "grey80"), name = paste0("p_adj < ", params$fdr)) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 6), limits = c(0, 10), name = "-log10(p_adj)\n(capped at 10)") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = lvl_name) +
    theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  print(p)
  save_plot(p, paste0("overview_", lvl_name, ".pdf"),
            width = 3 + 0.6 * nlevels(d$comparison), height = 2 + 0.25 * nlevels(d$cluster_id))
}
```

## Abundance per BM sample type

Every cluster on its own panel, with one box per BM sample type (`r paste(intersect(TIMEPOINT_LEVELS, unique(samples$timepoint)), collapse = " / ")`): % of the cells of the level's compartment per sample (descriptive; the tests are the comparisons above).

```{r abundance-by-timepoint, fig.width=14, fig.height=12}
tp_present <- intersect(TIMEPOINT_LEVELS, unique(samples$timepoint))
for (lvl_name in names(levels_cfg)) {
  lvl <- levels_cfg[[lvl_name]]
  d <- cells
  if (!is.null(lvl$compartment)) d <- d[as.character(d$metacluster) %in% lvl$compartment, ]
  d$cluster_id <- droplevels(d[[lvl$var]])
  d <- d[!is.na(d$cluster_id), ]
  n_comp <- table(d$fm_id)
  keep   <- names(n_comp)[n_comp >= params$min_cells_compartment]
  d <- d[d$fm_id %in% keep, ]
  if (!nrow(d)) next
  counts <- table(factor(d$fm_id, levels = keep), d$cluster_id)
  freq <- as.data.frame(as.table(100 * counts / rowSums(counts)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(freq) <- c("fm_id", "cluster_id", "Freq")
  freq$timepoint  <- factor(samples[freq$fm_id, "timepoint"], levels = tp_present)
  freq$cluster_id <- factor(freq$cluster_id, levels = levels(d$cluster_id))
  n_s <- table(samples[keep, "timepoint"])
  p <- ggplot(freq, aes(timepoint, Freq, fill = timepoint)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
    facet_wrap(~ cluster_id, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = COL_TIMEPOINT, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "\n(n=", as.integer(n_s[x]), ")"), drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "% abundance",
         title = paste0(lvl_name, if (!is.null(lvl$compartment)) " (within the compartment)" else "")) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 7))
  print(p)
  n_cl  <- nlevels(freq$cluster_id); n_col <- ceiling(sqrt(n_cl))
  save_plot(p, paste0("abundance_by_timepoint_", lvl_name, ".pdf"),
            width = 2.2 * n_col + 1, height = 2 * ceiling(n_cl / n_col) + 1)
}
```

## Relapse patients with an earlier BM sample

The patients with a relapse (REL) sample and at least one other BM sample (DE, T1 or T2): every cluster on its own panel, one line per patient joining that patient's samples (% of the cells of the level's compartment; the mean when a patient has several samples at one timepoint). Descriptive; `REL_vs_DE` above is the test.

```{r relapse-patients, fig.width=14, fig.height=12}
rel_pat <- unique(samples$patient_id[samples$timepoint == "REL"])
rel_pat <- rel_pat[vapply(rel_pat, function(p) any(samples$timepoint[samples$patient_id == p] %in% c("DE", "T1", "T2")), logical(1))]
cat("Relapse patients with an earlier BM sample:", length(rel_pat), "\n")
if (length(rel_pat)) {
  tp_rel  <- intersect(c("DE", "T1", "T2", "REL"), unique(samples$timepoint[samples$patient_id %in% rel_pat]))
  col_pat <- setNames(grDevices::hcl.colors(max(3, length(rel_pat)), "Dark 3")[seq_along(rel_pat)], rel_pat)
  for (lvl_name in names(levels_cfg)) {
    lvl <- levels_cfg[[lvl_name]]
    d <- cells[cells$fm_id %in% samples$fm_id[samples$patient_id %in% rel_pat & samples$timepoint %in% tp_rel], ]
    if (!is.null(lvl$compartment)) d <- d[as.character(d$metacluster) %in% lvl$compartment, ]
    d$cluster_id <- droplevels(d[[lvl$var]])
    d <- d[!is.na(d$cluster_id), ]
    n_comp <- table(d$fm_id)
    d <- d[d$fm_id %in% names(n_comp)[n_comp >= params$min_cells_compartment], ]
    if (!nrow(d)) next
    counts <- table(factor(d$fm_id), d$cluster_id)
    freq <- as.data.frame(as.table(100 * counts / rowSums(counts)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(freq) <- c("fm_id", "cluster_id", "Freq")
    freq$patient   <- samples[freq$fm_id, "patient_id"]
    freq$timepoint <- samples[freq$fm_id, "timepoint"]
    freq <- freq %>% group_by(patient, timepoint, cluster_id) %>% summarise(Freq = mean(Freq), .groups = "drop")
    freq$timepoint  <- factor(freq$timepoint, levels = tp_rel)
    freq$cluster_id <- factor(freq$cluster_id, levels = levels(d$cluster_id))
    p <- ggplot(freq, aes(timepoint, Freq, colour = patient, group = patient)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_point(size = 1.8) +
      facet_wrap(~ cluster_id, scales = "free_y") +
      scale_colour_manual(values = col_pat) +
      scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "% abundance", colour = "patient",
           title = paste0(lvl_name, if (!is.null(lvl$compartment)) " (within the compartment)" else "",
                          ": relapse patients with an earlier BM sample")) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
      theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 7))
    print(p)
    n_cl  <- nlevels(freq$cluster_id); n_col <- ceiling(sqrt(n_cl))
    save_plot(p, paste0("relapse_patients_", lvl_name, ".pdf"),
              width = 2.2 * n_col + 2, height = 2 * ceiling(n_cl / n_col) + 1)
  }
}
```
